full.description: This is a clinical photograph of a human foot and lower leg. The skin appears relatively smooth and taut, and there is a scale marker positioned near the ankle for measurement. A dark, necrotic lesion, characteristic of gangrene, is visible on the great toe. The overall presentation is consistent with ischemic necrosis or gangrene of the extremity.

random.description: This image is a clinical photograph of a foot and lower leg showing a severe ischemic lesion. A dark, necrotic, and ulcerated area is clearly visible on the great toe. The surrounding skin appears pale and shiny, indicative of poor circulation or chronic ischemia. Such findings are characteristic of severe peripheral vascular disease leading to tissue gangrene.
